hdsf.yaml:
# Fictional example: a wellness app that meets HDSF level 3 in its manifest and code.
hdsf_version: "0.2"
product:
  name: Calm Steps (example)
  version: 2.3.0
  url: https://example.org/calm-steps
  maker: Example Wellbeing, Lda.
  contact: privacy@example.org
intended_purpose: >
  Helps adults build habits of walking, sleep and relaxation by logging daily steps, sleep hours and short breathing
  sessions, and showing simple weekly summaries. It gives general wellbeing information only.
profiles: [core, W]
users: [public]
features: [accounts, wearables, notifications]
countries: [PT, ES]
qualification:
  medical_device: none
  class: null
  notified_body: null
  rationale: docs/qualification.md
data:
  gdpr_role: controller        # controller | processor | joint_controller | mixed
  records: docs/records.md   # record of processing activities (GDPR Art. 30)
  dpia: docs/dpia.md
  retention: "Account and logs until deletion; inactive accounts deleted after 24 months; backups 35 days"
  purposes:
    - {name: provide the service, basis: contract, art9: explicit_consent}
    - {name: service statistics, basis: legitimate_interest, art9: none, health_data: false}
  rights: {access: in-app history, export: settings/export (JSON), delete: settings/delete-account}
  storage_regions: [eu-west-1]
  third_parties:
    - {name: Cloud hosting, purpose: hosting and database, jurisdiction: IE, receives_health_data: true, dpa: docs/dpa-hosting.md}
    - {name: Email service, purpose: account emails, jurisdiction: DE, receives_health_data: false, dpa: docs/dpa-email.md}
  tracking_on_health_screens: false
  ads: none
security:
  policy: SECURITY.md
  incident_plan: docs/incident-plan.md
  sbom: ci
safety:
  emergency_route: "Help link in the menu; the app says it is not an emergency service"
  content_review: docs/content-review.md
ehds:
  ehr_system: false
  claims_ehr_interoperability: false
nis2:
  status: not_in_scope
review:
  last_reviewed: 2026-11-20
waivers: []
texts/onboarding.md:
# Onboarding texts (example)

Welcome to Calm Steps. This app helps you build small habits. It is not a medical device. It is not an emergency service: in an emergency, call 112.

You choose what to track. You can change this at any time. Your data stays in the EU.

Every week you see a short summary. You can share it with someone you trust. You decide what to share.

Walking a little more each day can help you feel better. Start with ten minutes. Add five minutes each week. Rest when you need to.
texts/privacy.md:
# Privacy policy (example)

Example Wellbeing, Lda. is the data controller. You can contact us at privacy@example.org. Our data protection officer is reachable at dpo@example.org.

We use your data to give you weekly summaries of your steps, sleep and breathing sessions. These are health data, a special category of data. We only use them with your explicit consent, which you can withdraw at any time in Settings. Our legal basis for the account itself is the contract with you.

Our hosting provider in Ireland stores your data for us under a processing contract. We do not share your data with advertisers. We do not transfer your data outside the EU.

We keep your data until you delete your account. If you do not use the app for 24 months, we delete your account.

You have the right of access, rectification, erasure, portability and the right to object. Write to us and we answer within one month. You can also lodge a complaint with the supervisory authority, the CNPD.

We do not make automated decisions about you.
